mode: Fictional deterministic local execution; no real participant, provider measurement, database or HTTP network called by this export script.

sponsorCtr.definition: Distinct matched impression IDs clicked / distinct impression IDs in the UTC window.

inquiryCompletion.definition: Started property/correlation sessions resolved without escalation / started sessions. Successful-inquiry proxy; no caller identity or first-call history.

webhookFallback.definition: Started sessions with webhook_timeout or fallback_transfer / started sessions.

propertyInquiry.definition: Listing-view sessions with a property-details, availability or booking intent / listing-view sessions.

latencySla.definition: Completed sessions with supplied fixture latency <1000ms / completed sessions with that latency source. Missing measurements excluded.

callCompletion.definition: Started sessions with a completion event / started sessions.

toolSuccess.definition: Successful tool-result events / all tool-result events.

escalation.definition: Started sessions with any escalation / started sessions.

providerOnlyLatencyMetric.definition: Completed sessions with supplied provider_measured latency <1000ms / completed sessions with that latency source. Missing measurements excluded.
